name: 人物美姿生成（转弯顺露）
description: 将摄影美姿中的转、弯、顺、露原则转换为可执行的人物文生图提示词，优先生成有破面、破线、连贯肢体线条和清晰手部落点的人像照片。
prompt_template: {subject}, {framing}, {stance}, {facing}, {bend}, {gesture}, {line_flow}, {hand_visibility}, {silhouette}, {scene}, {lighting}, photorealistic portrait photography, natural anatomy, coherent body proportions
negative_prompt_template: {negative_prompt}, generic stiff pose, head torso legs facing the same direction, flat silhouette, awkward joint bends, broken limb lines, hidden hands, fused fingers, extra fingers, missing fingers, cropped feet, distorted anatomy, mannequin pose, blurry face, plastic skin, low quality, watermark

defaults.subject: an adult person with distinctive facial features
defaults.framing: full-body portrait, feet visible in frame
defaults.stance: standing in a relaxed three-quarter pose
defaults.facing: torso turned slightly away, face turned back toward the camera
defaults.bend: head slightly tilted, one knee softly bent, the rest of the body relaxed
defaults.gesture: one hand lightly touching the brim of a hat, the other arm relaxed
defaults.line_flow: forearm flows naturally into the hand, thigh line continues into the pointed foot, relaxed wrists and ankles
defaults.hand_visibility: both hands have clear resting points and visible fingers, no ambiguous occlusion
defaults.silhouette: upper body open and lower body gathered for a balanced breathing silhouette
defaults.scene: quiet urban street at golden hour
defaults.lighting: soft directional side light with gentle shadow transition
